summary: RenX Enterprises Corp. disclosed that Norman Berry II Owner, LLC, a 50%-owned affiliate, signed a Purchase and Sale Agreement on August 17, 2026 to sell an approximately 7.7-acre East Point, Fulton County, Georgia parcel to Arbour Valley Development, LLC for $2.6 million cash. Closing is conditioned on the buyer receiving Georgia State Agency tax-credit, HOME funds, or electing not to apply. Earnest money of $60,000 is due within ten business days, plus $60,000 after the application period, both refundable pre-application; deposits credit to price at closing. Watch tax-credit award timing expected March 2027 and termination risk if no allocation.
